home.text2: FitoFarm-2024 is a pharmaceutical company founded in Georgia, producing biologically active dietary supplements (BAS).
home.text3: The products manufactured by the company are made from natural plant-based materials, creating safe and effective remedies.

about.title: About FitoFarm-2024
about.whoText1: FitoFarm-2024 is a pharmaceutical company established in Georgia, specializing in the production of biologically active dietary supplements (BAS).
about.whoText2: We believe that health is not a privilege - it is the right of every person. That is why we create products that are effective, safe, and accessible.
about.productsText: The FitoFarm-2024 manufacturing facility is located in a high-mountain region of Georgia, in the Tkibuli municipality, where we produce products with 100% natural plant-based composition in an ecologically clean environment. Each product undergoes strict quality control procedures to ensure we provide our customers with the finest goods.
about.reason1Title: High Georgian quality - 100% natural plant-based formula.
about.reason1Text: We combine the richness of Georgian nature with modern pharmaceutical manufacturing methods to international standards, creating a world-class product that contains no artificial colorants, preservatives, or synthetic additives - only a natural, ecological, and pure composition.
about.reason2Text: Every ingredient in the product is listed on the label. We do not hide the composition - our customers are always informed about what they are giving their body.
about.reason3Text: FitoFarm-2024 holds all permits issued by the relevant authorities of Georgia. Our products meet all applicable norms and standards. Fitosedi drops have been in demand on the international market for 30 years.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.text: Our team is prepared to collaborate on any public relations matters you might have. Whether it’s a proposal, expanding a partnership, or a pertinent inquiry, we invite you to fill out our contact form. This will ensure your message reaches us directly via email, enabling us to address your needs efficiently and effectively.
